Name: Lake beach
Description: Waves on a lake's sandy beach (ShoreSpec.LakeSand, ShoreSynth): small spilling breakers, the swash running up the sand and soaking in with a fizz. Its box is the stretch of edge it stands for: X its length along the edge, Z the fetch, how far the water reaches straight out from it; turn the entity so its +Z faces the water. Silent in a calm. Not a recording and not a loop.
